3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: The Maroon Train slowly started to move.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: Among camera flashes and cheers, we departed from the Holsord central train station. Our destination was Perla, the capital of Lespia. The historic route we were using was also called The Southern Express.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: This train had been in service for many years. It had nine locomotives with special quarters and an office. As the name implied, it was painted bright maroon.

6.speaker: Symon Holl
6.text: “Also, we need to be careful. I heard that he is a shrewd man.”

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: We passed through the Lespian mountain range to the lowlands, with a short stop at the beautiful Sarea Nueva where Lespian security forces joined us.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: Looking outside the window, the difference in wealth between Valgen and Sarea Nueva was extraordinary.

9.speaker: Symon Holl
9.text: “This happened just yesterday. Apparently he was so drunk that he couldn't get off the plane on a diplomatic visit.”

10.speaker: Player
10.text: “Is this something that could affect this trade deal?”

11.speaker: Symon Holl
11.text: “We are almost at Perla. I will return to my cabin now.”

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: I heard a knock on the door to my office on the train and Symon entered.

15.speaker: Narrator
15.text: Although I knew that he was one of the youngest state leaders in the world, I was still surprised by how boyish he looked. At his age, he was leading one of the strongest countries in Eastern Merkopa.

18.speaker: Player_Italic
18.text: Leave the broken handle next to the teapot.

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: He gestured towards the two couches and we sat down face-to-face.

20.speaker: Symon Holl
20.text: “I wanted to have a quick chat about Prime Minister Alvarez and give you a heads up.”

21.speaker: Narrator
21.text: He sat down on a chair in front of my desk.

22.speaker: Narrator
22.text: He was holding his head like he had a headache and he was stumbling. Upon seeing me, he immediately composed himself. We shook hands.

23.speaker: Symon Holl
23.text: “I do. I am sure we will be fine, Mr. President.”

25.speaker: Symon Holl
25.text: “There have been some rumours about his...demeanour in public appearances.”

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: The door opened and Patricio Alvarez entered.

27.speaker: Player
27.text: “What do you mean? What did he do?”

30.speaker: Symon Holl
30.text: “I am sure we will be fine, Mr. President.”

31.speaker: Narrator
31.text: The convoy came to a stop and I made my way to the entrance. The assistants directed me to a room to wait for Prime Minister Alvarez.

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: A few minutes later, with a long whistle, our train came to a stop. I waved to the crowd from the window.

33.speaker: Symon Holl
33.text: “He is known to have met with other state leaders while intoxicated on various occasions.”

35.speaker: Narrator
35.text: The Yellow House was situated at the very centre of Perla in the middle of a circular park that was off limits to regular citizens. The park was full of roses on small patches.

36.speaker: Player_Italic
36.text: Hide it behind a nearby plant.

39.speaker: Player
39.text: “So the man can't handle his drink. Is that it?”

40.speaker: Symon Holl
40.text: “Although his premiership is riddled with these kind of incidents, I also heard that he is a shrewd man.”

41.speaker: Symon Holl
41.text: “Regardless, I don't think we should underestimate them. They hold substantial economic power, after all.”

43.speaker: Player
43.text: “It should be fine. I have dealt with worse than that before.”

46.speaker: Narrator
46.text: The crowds of reporters that flocked over were pushed away by the Lespian security guards. We made our way to our cars and the convoy began its short trip to the Yellow House.

48.speaker: Narrator
48.text: I went back to my chair.

49.speaker: Symon Holl
49.text: “I don't think there will be any issues either. I just wanted to give you a heads up.”

51.speaker: Player
51.text: “Thanks for giving me a heads up.”

52.speaker: Symon Holl
52.text: “After this incident, some say he is unfit to serve. But I don't believe that at all.”

54.speaker: Symon Holl
54.text: “We need to be careful. I heard that he is a shrewd man.”

55.speaker: Narrator
55.text: He handed me a newspaper. The headline was 'Circling Over Staalport'.

56.speaker: Narrator
56.text: After ten minutes. there was still no sign of Prime Minister Alvarez. It was almost time for our meeting.

57.speaker: Narrator
57.text: While I was touching it, the handle broke off. I looked around. Thankfully no one was in the room.

58.speaker: Player
58.text: “I hope he doesn't show up drunk to our meeting too.”

61.speaker: Player
61.text: “These are the Lespians people fear? Ridiculous.”

62.speaker: Narrator
62.text: My chair started to feel uncomfortable. I stood up and walked around to look at the various items in the room. A beautiful golden teapot piqued my interest.
